name: Redactor
purpose: Structlog processor that redacts PII-shaped substrings (emails, CC numbers, tokens, etc.) from every string value in an event dict, in-place. Called on the logging hot path; MUST be O(1) in event-dict size for non-string values and never raise.
invariants: REDACTOR_INV_01: `__call__` MUST return the SAME event_dict object it received (in-place mutation) so downstream structlog processors see the redacted payload.
REDACTOR_INV_02: Non-string values (ints, lists, objects) MUST pass through UNCHANGED — the redactor only rewrites string values.
REDACTOR_INV_03: No matter what malformed input arrives, `__call__` MUST NOT raise; a logging processor that throws breaks the entire logging pipeline.
